answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a reef as the anchor of the cost.
